name: MonarchTruncatedText
title: TruncatedText
summary: Text cut after a few lines, with a button that shows the rest.
whenToUse: For notes, descriptions and comments of unknown length inside a card, a row or a detail screen.
whenNotToUse: For a title that must stay on one line with no way to expand, use Text with lineLimit(1). For long documents, show the text in full on its own screen.
api: init(_ text: String, lineLimit: Int = 3, isExpandable: Bool = true, showMoreLabel: String? = nil, showLessLabel: String? = nil)
init(_ text: String, lineLimit: Int = 3, isExpanded: Binding<Bool>, isExpandable: Bool = true, showMoreLabel: String? = nil, showLessLabel: String? = nil)

options.name: lineLimit
options.description: How many lines are shown before the text is cut. Values below 1 count as 1.

options.name: isExpanded
options.description: Whether the whole text is shown. Without it the component keeps the state itself, starting cut.

options.name: isExpandable
options.description: Whether a button shows the rest when the text is cut.

states.name: cut
states.description: The text is longer than the limit: it ends with an ellipsis and the button reads "Show more".

states.name: expanded
states.description: All lines are shown and the button reads "Show less".

states.name: fits
states.description: The text is within the limit: no button.

appearance: Body text in the default text colour; the button is label text in the link colour with no fill, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web tooltip option is not offered: there is no hover on touch, and VoiceOver reads the whole text without it. The web accepts inline elements (links, emphasis); this takes a plain String. Whether the text is cut is measured with two hidden copies of the text, because SwiftUI does not report truncation. Android builds the same component.
accessibility: VoiceOver reads the whole text whether or not it is cut, because it is one Text with a line limit.
The button is a standard button whose title changes between "Show more" and "Show less"; both titles can be replaced.
The button's touch target is at least 44 points high.
Expanding and collapsing is animated unless Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: The button appears after the first layout pass, when the heights are known.
With isExpandable false the cut text has no visible way to expand; use it only where the whole text is one tap away.
An empty string shows nothing and no button.
With a binding that is true and text that fits, the button still shows so the state can be turned off.

examples.title: Three lines with Show more
examples.code:
MonarchTruncatedText(
    "Quarterly planning notes covering hiring for the support team, the roadmap for the next two releases, the migration of the reporting service to the new storage layer and the open questions we still need answers to before the review.",
    lineLimit: 3
)

examples.title: The app holds the state
examples.code:
MonarchTruncatedText(
    "Call the site manager before noon to arrange access, and update the order once the pallets are signed for.",
    lineLimit: 1,
    isExpanded: $showsWholeNote
)
